counterexample.construction: Sample h and a whole-plane SLE8 eta independently, set eta1=eta2=eta and area-parametrize both. Set psi(0)=1, psi(t)=t for0<t<=1.
counterexample.all_assumptions: Allowed gamma/kappa; correct curve marginals; pair independent from h; identical coupling expressly permitted; common area parametrization; Borel selector; equality1.1 holds at0 by eta(0)=eta(1)=infinity and elsewhere by identical curves.
counterexample.calculation: pi(B)=integral_0^1 1_B(t,t)dt; support diagonal; fibre at0 is{0}, while psi(0)=1. Point(0,1) is outside support.
counterexample.decisive_result: Printed final assertion fails at a fixed deterministic endpoint on every admissible realization.

checks_by_claim.source_location: General coupling PDF pp.3–4; Lemmas 2.8–2.10 pp.23–24; property (vi) p.21
checks_by_claim.verification: Set gamma=1, kappa1=kappa2=8 and eta1=eta2=eta, with eta independent of h and common mass parametrisation. The Borel selector psi(0)=1, psi(t)=t for t>0 satisfies eta1(t)=eta2(psi(t)), including the common endpoint infinity. A singleton modification leaves diagonal Lebesgue permuton measure unchanged. Its closed support has fibre {0} at t=0, while psi(0)=1. All relevant general-coupling hypotheses hold, and no selector endpoint normalisation excludes the construction.
checks_by_claim.counterevidence: The conditional first assertion requires a uniquely hit target point and does not apply to infinity. Property (vi) is for z in C. The source itself confirms diagonal support in the identical-curve example.

checks_by_claim.source_location: Lemma 2.8 p.23; Lemma 2.10 p.24; Theorems 1.13 and 1.22
checks_by_claim.verification: Lemma 2.8 supplies a common Lebesgue-null set of bad times. Off it, the first conditional assertion of Lemma 2.10 proves the almost-every-time or independent-uniform-time replacement. This does not prove an all-fixed-interior-time version for arbitrary coupling. Core LIS/rerooting statements have stricter coupling assumptions; identical curves violate the independent-curve hypothesis of Theorem 1.22, and endpoint shifts agree modulo one.
checks_by_claim.severity_reason: Demonstrated damage is the over-quantified local endpoint assertion. No core LIS or rerooting counterexample is established. Minor follows from actual scope, not ease of repair.
